other_unk_policy.if_above_threshold: relabel to the highest official class and accept
other_unk_policy.otherwise: retry; after three total attempts mark Other for manual review

prompts.Happiness: Happy: bright, warm, lively, light rhythm.
prompts.Anger: Angry, indignant, controlled; emphatic key words, varied pace, falling stress.
prompts.Disgust: Disgusted but controlled: clear aversion and recoil, clipped phrase groups, brief tense pauses, slight scoffing downward inflection on emphasized words. Never happy or angry.
